survey.name: Social feed
survey.res: A tray of tomatoes, garlic and chickpeas: roast until the edges catch, then spoon over toast.
Kitchen notes
The switchback looks steep from below. From the ridge, the whole valley opens up.
Trail journal
Three painted front doors from a walk with no destination. The yellow one wins today.
Around the block
Low tide leaves little channels in the sand. Every walk along this shore takes a different route.
Coastal notebook
Basil cuttings rooted in a glass of water this week. Time to find them a bigger home.
Growing things
A short story collection is ideal for the ten minutes between dinner and doing the dishes.
Reading corner
Try painting the same view with just three colors. The missing colors make you look harder.
Studio notes
The picnic plan: pears, sharp cheese, a blanket and a place under the trees.
Weekend table
The best part of baking bread is the first slice, still warm enough to melt the butter.
Kitchen notes
A quiet back street can turn a routine bike ride into the nicest part of the day.
City rides
Today’s coffee experiment: a slightly coarser grind and a slower pour. A softer cup.
Morning ritual
Pack an extra layer for the ridge. The sheltered start tells you very little about the wind above.
Trail journal
A tiny front garden can hold a lot: rosemary by the gate, marigolds along the path.
Around the block
Sketching boats is mostly an exercise in looking at the spaces between the ropes.
Coastal notebook
Turn a windowsill pot a quarter turn each week to help the stems grow evenly.
Growing things
A book swap idea: tuck a handwritten, spoiler-free recommendation inside the cover.
Reading corner
A scrap of cardboard makes a surprisingly good paint scraper. These hills started as one broad stroke.
Studio notes
Cloudy picnic weather has one advantage: the good patch of grass is usually empty.
Weekend table
Save the heel of the loaf. Tomorrow it becomes crunchy crumbs for a bowl of pasta.
Kitchen notes
A short check before leaving: tires firm, brakes responsive, lights working.
City rides
A favorite mug, a sunny table, and five quiet minutes before the first meeting.
Morning ritual
The long route follows the stream. The short route goes straight up. Today feels like a stream day.
Trail journal
Look up on your next neighborhood walk. There are small architectural details above almost every shop.
Around the block
The horizon is a useful reminder to leave a little empty space in a drawing.
Coastal notebook
A finger in the soil is a better watering reminder than a fixed day on the calendar.
Growing things
Reading two very different books at once means there is always something for the mood you are in.
Reading corner
Mix a little of yesterday’s color into today’s palette. A series starts to feel connected.
Studio notes
An ordinary lunch tastes different outside. Even the nearest patch of green will do.
Weekend table
A small bowl of herby yogurt makes roasted vegetables feel like a complete meal.
Kitchen notes
The route with fewer junctions is sometimes more relaxing than the route with fewer miles.
